Обзор: Strawberry Vinegar — Рецепт счастья с привкусом мистики
Статус: Рекомендую (всем, кто любит трогательные истории и эстетику еды).

Сюжет крутится вокруг девятилетней Сакубы — ворчливой и одинокой девочки, чья жизнь меняется, когда в её доме появляется Личи — самопровозглашенный демон из ада, который... просто очень хочет есть.

1. Невероятно аппетитный арт
Если вы любите фуд-порн в искусстве, эта игра — для вас.

Рисовка еды: Каждое блюдо, которое Личи поглощает с огромным аппетитом, прорисовано настолько детально и сочно, что во время прохождения лучше иметь под рукой перекус.

Дизайн персонажей: Сакуба и Личи выглядят очаровательно. Их выразительные лица и смена эмоций добавляют истории жизни и динамики.

2. От сатиры до искренней драмы
Сценарий мастерски балансирует между юмором и серьезными темами.

Забавные диалоги: Постоянные перепалки между циничной Сакубой и вечно голодной Личи вызывают искреннюю улыбку.

Глубокий подтекст: За милой оберткой скрываются размышления о скоротечности времени, о том, как важно открываться людям и ценить тепло родного дома. Игра умеет заставить игрока сопереживать до слез.

3. Кулинарное путешествие
Игра пропитана любовью к готовке.

Домашний уют: Отец Сакубы — профессиональный повар, и процесс приготовления пищи здесь представлен как акт любви и заботы. Это создает очень теплую, «ламповую» атмосферу.

Разнообразие: Вы узнаете много нового о японской (и не только) кухне, что делает игру не только приятной, но и познавательной.

4. Множественные концовки
Ваши действия напрямую влияют на то, чем закончится это необычное знакомство.

Вариативность: В игре есть как «плохие», так и «хорошие» финалы. Путь к истинной концовке требует внимания к чувствам персонажей.

Послание: Каждая концовка несет в себе определенный жизненный урок, оставляя приятное (или горькое, но важное) послевкусие.

5. Атмосферное сопровождение
Музыка: Легкие, жизнерадостные мелодии сменяются меланхоличными композициями, идеально подчеркивая смену настроения в сюжете.

Темп: Новелла читается легко и быстро, она идеально подходит для того, чтобы уютно устроиться с чашкой чая и полностью погрузиться в историю.

Итог:
Strawberry Vinegar — это настоящая «комфортная еда» (comfort food) в мире видеоигр. Она согревает душу, радует глаз и напоминает о том, что самые простые вещи — например, совместный обед — могут быть самыми важными в жизни.

Осторожно: вызывает острое желание съесть что-нибудь сладкое!

I originally saw this on the Nintendo E-shop and was interested for years because of the artwork but never bought it because I thought a VN would be boring.  I was wrong.  This is a very sweet story and I am very glad I finally played it.

As much, as I would like to write positive review for this novel, I unfortunately can’t do it, without being dishonest to myself. 
This game advertises itself as a “cute comedy“ however, it’s hard to find humor in this story. There are few moments, that can make you snicker, but that is about it.  I know that author can write in funny parts well. (Look “Blackberry honey”, “The way we all go”) This story is missing it, especially for a “comedy”. What is not missing, are huge amounts of fluff.  You can find a lot of it in “Strawberry vinegar”, even in the title. It unfortunately isn’t enough by itself, to make the story good.  The plot of SV is simply put, forgettable. There is nothing in it, that could create tension or make us bond with characters, causing me to loose the will to read further. I finished the game in 100% to be able to say that, I in fact experienced all, what this story has to offer. However, it still couldn’t change the aftertaste, the “vinegar” left in my mouth.  If you are looking for something, that is simply very cute and that is it, then this story is for you, if not then you should choose different story of this author. 
What is worth noting, is the art of actual food that this story is centered around. The graphics are enjoyable and pretty. Definitely not something, that you should read when you are hungry. It however won’t saturate your hunger for good sfx or music. This part of the story is not above acceptability.  You shouldn’t expect a lot from this department.  

If you look for fluff, this story is for you. Anything else? You won’t find it here.

Strawberry Vinegar is a unique and adorable romance visual novel between a couple of girls, both of which seem to have an unhealthy, yet childishly cute obsession over sweets and desserts.  It has heartwarming dialogue and overly descriptive narrations of unbelievably delicious sweet dishes.  Don't worry though as the relationship between the two kids take priority over the food descriptions.  

This is obviously a super SFW visual novel with zero adult'ish content whatsoever.  It also has choices required by the reader that affects the outcome of the story.  I am personally not a fan of this decision-making style of visual novels, but there are spoiler-free guides you can refer to and obtain whichever of the endings you'd prefer to see.  

I'd highly recommend Strawberry Vinegar to visual novel fans looking for a cute yuri romance story.

Rieはひねくれ者でいつもツンツンしてる9才の女の子。ある日、どこからともなくRieの家に現れた自称悪魔の子Licia。「美味しいものを食わせろ！じゃないと魂を刈り取っちゃうぞ！」と脅され、ドタバタな1週間を過ごす。おいしい食べ物と、悪魔と、百合で満ちたハートフルストーリー。

紹介動画からも分かる通り、食べ物と百合がテーマとなっている短編のビジュアルノベル。
食べ物のCGがどれも美味しそうなのが憎い。見てるとお腹が空いてくる。タイトルからしてデザートしか出てこないのかと思いきや、みそ汁や漬物など普通の料理もでてくる。というか意外にも日本が舞台となっているので和食がいっぱい出てきます。やったぜ。ebi-himeさんの他の作品を読んだことのある方なら分かると思うけど、彼女の緻密で丁寧な情景描写が食べ物に対しても遺憾なく発揮されてます。物語はRieちゃん視点で進行しますが、9才とは思えないくらい流暢に食レポしてくれるのは笑った。

定番料理から色物まで様々な食べ物が登場するので、次は何の料理・デザートがでてくるんだろうとワクワクしながら読んでました。実績は殆どが食べ物にまつわるものとなっているのも面白い。

選択肢ありのマルチエンディングで、選択肢によってはRieとLiciaの関係は友情になったり、百合になったりします。ツンツンしてるRieがLiciaにどんどん絆されてデレデレになっていくの最高にかわいい。

全成就并且每一条线的剧情都完整看过了，不得不说这剧情真的太多槽点了，下面是一些主观的个人观点，含有部分暴躁过激发言，涉及剧透，仅供参考。

  第二，女主爹妈踏马的是女A男O第四爱……里面有两条支线有她爸爸跌进水池子里浑身湿透的剧情，甚至还有单独的湿身CG……打HE接近结局的时候你还能看到很大篇幅的女主爹妈的爱情故事，不是说第四爱或者BG不好，但我相信大家买这个游戏是为了看百合的吧？简介里也没有任何说明有这种剧情的存在啊？我要是想看BG或者第四爱大把多的渠道ok？女主她妈甚至还给她科普SM，说她爹是M她妈是S……hello？这是可以说的吗？这是一个9岁小女孩能听的吗？看到这些剧情我整个人都有被无语到。
  第三，还有更让我无语的——我就算再无脑磕糖也不能无脑到磕两个9岁小女孩吧？！谁写的剧情您有事吗？？？女主她爹自己都吐槽女主甚至都还不算teenager！上网一查青少年都是从13岁才开始算的！女主才9岁啊！我真的是救命了！现实姬圈普遍恋姐的情况下我看到女主这个9岁真的是眼前一黑，游戏里还通篇各种强调女主只有9岁！你哪怕是个teenager我都不觉得有啥啊！而且9岁女主的同班同学甚至还有磕她俩cp的，还要写她俩的同人文！不是，是我跟时代脱节了吗？我一看这游戏16年出的，也不至于啊？我也不是说硬要在二次元里找真实，但这剧情人设能不能有点逻辑啊？百合游戏的门槛就这么低吗？玩了这么多，剧情不及格的占一大半，是不及格！写剧情立人设能不能用点心啊，真把人当傻子呢？

Such a cute game! One of the best visual novels I have played. The art is adorable, I love all of the pinks and pastels. The character design is cute and the desserts look so sweet I wish I could eat them! The game had no technical issues, no unnecessary effects/glitches and ran smoothly. The story is unique, about a demon from hell who decides to visit the main character's home for 6 days to experience Japan (mostly the food). The relationship between the 2 characters develops nicely, and even though they are both only 9 I still found myself rooting for them to be together. Their personalities were perfect for each other, one really clingy and open, and the other a tsundere. Their relationship was innocent and not perverse (which is common for many visual novels..).  The writing was really good, no grammatical mistakes (a lot of visual novels have bad writing/translation so this game was a huge improvement), and I found the humor funny, which I also find to be lacking in many games.

Overall, I recommend this game for anyone who likes cute things, likes desserts, and would enjoy a lighthearted and innocent romantic storyline.

Strawberry Vinegar is a sweet visual novel--both sweet in the sense that it's heartwarming, and sweet as in there's some pretty amazing art of some delectable desserts (and other types of food).

Nine-year-old Sakuraba Rie, smart far beyond her years, enters her kitchen to discover a mysterious girl with horns and a tail eating the cookies she had been baking. This thief is Licia, a young demon of gluttony, and she gives Rie an ultimatum: feed Licia delicious food every day for a week, or she'll reap Rie's soul.

Thus begins a lighthearted romp in the new life of Rie, Licia, and Rie's parents Yukine (an actress) and Kazuki (a househusband...or he would be if he and Yukine were actually married--this particular point is never elaborated on). Rie is the only person who knows that Licia is a demon; despite the horns and the tail and Licia regularly proclaiming that she's a demon from Hell, everyone else, from Rie's classmates to her parents, is absolutely 100% convinced that Licia is simply Norwegian. Some people might find the Norway gag runs a bit too long, although I personally found it funny every time.

All of the main characters are hilarious in their own ways. Rie is clearly far smarter than the average nine-year-old; her complex way of speaking is clearly unrealistic for an elementary schooler, but I felt that it added to the humor of the whole thing. Licia's naive, food-obsessed, and all of her knowledge of Japan comes from her otaku mother, leading to a bunch of misconceptions. Yukine is playfully sadistic. Kazuki is comic relief even by this cast's standards; he's extremely emotional and the primary target of Yukine's teasing (although [i]that's[/i] something he doesn't seem to mind too much) and often gets saddled with bad luck.

You might be wondering, "An anime-style visual novel about a romance between two nine-year-old girls? Uh, isn't that KINDA SKETCH?" (And, you know, that's fair.) However, I can guarantee that Strawberry Vinegar is totally wholesome. The only moment that could even be questionable is Licia wanting to bathe with Rie near the beginning of the story, but it's played totally innocently and all the options have Rie refusing anyway. (One of the options is, quote, "This isn't that kind of story.") There's also some light jokes about the nature of Kazuki's and Yukine's relationship, but nothing that could qualify as lewd. Even the romance is as chaste as you can get, being closer to puppy love than the type of romance you'd see between older characters. [spoiler]The story includes epilogues for the friendship and romance endings which take place when Rie and Licia are both adults; they're girlfriends in the romantic epilogue, and there's some kissing, but nothing more.[/spoiler]

The art is absolutely gorgeous. The character sprites and CGs have a beautiful and detailed painterly style. The food CGs [i]will[/i] make you hungry. (It made [i]me[/i] hungry, anyway.) The music is appropriate for the story, although none of the tracks particularly stand out.

While it does have a couple of bad endings (in the sense of "bad things happen", not "bad quality") and some light drama, overall, Strawberry Vinegar is a feel-good story that's almost guaranteed to lift your spirits as it also provides a feast for the eyes.
